protocol.metric: Frobenius absolute and relative error over all n*n entries; no row renormalization
protocol.storage_unit: one stored number, not bits; shared geometry is not charged per matrix
protocol.statistical_unit: document; resample whole document blocks and recompute instance median

selection.design: one archived head per document; exact balanced layer quotas; secondary head balancing; seeded tie-breaks
selection.reason: Synthetic full-grid n=256 CUDA pilot: 17.8 seconds per 100 updates; at 450 updates full n=256 archive alone exceeds 220 GPU hours. Sparse CPU and renderer engineering measured before selection.

uniform.normalization: unit Frobenius norm after causal restriction

profiled.normalization: unit Frobenius norm after causal restriction

radon.normalization: unit Frobenius norm after causal restriction
radon.rank_evidence: positive smallest Ritz value; numerical estimate, not exact rank proof

profiled.normalization: unit Frobenius norm after causal restriction

radon.normalization: unit Frobenius norm after causal restriction

protocol.parametric_rendering: unit-norm exp(-q^2/2-decay*t)*(max(1-q^2/36,0))^3; q=normal distance/width; C2 compact transverse support; exact sparse rendering; causal

parametric_constraints.amplitude: [0, ||A||]; this contains every coordinatewise nonnegative optimum for unit-norm nonnegative atoms

optimizer_frozen.normalization: log-domain including transverse taper, avoiding norm-square underflow
optimizer_frozen.amplitude_bound_reason: For nonnegative unit-norm atoms and a unit-norm target, every coordinatewise nonnegative optimum has amplitude <=1
optimizer_frozen.control_policy: Same fixed targets, seeds and acceptance thresholds; preserve and report all failed controls

environment.note: C2 compact transverse profile is exactly rendered in sparse CUDA; CPU finite-difference gradcheck and CUDA comparison passed. CUDA atomic sums permit small floating-point nondeterminism.

decisions.question: Full archive versus stratified subset?
decisions.suggestion: 64 matrices/dataset, one per document with layer quotas and head balancing

decisions.question: Which common storage budgets?
decisions.suggestion: (2n+1)*[1,2,4], independent of observed errors; same-k reported separately

decisions.question: How to interpret failed positive controls?
decisions.suggestion: Keep error gates unchanged and retain all cases; restrict negative claims

decisions.question: How to estimate the Radon inverse conditioning?
decisions.suggestion: Extremal eigenvalues of R transpose R on causal pixels; 180/360 angles

decisions.question: How to make gradient fitting affordable?
decisions.suggestion: Fused CUDA kernels for exact sparse compact-support rendering; validate against dense values and gradients

decisions.question: How to strengthen continuous fitting without changing the representation budget?
decisions.suggestion: Four fixed starts, including multiscale proposals, and L-BFGS-B after Adam; freeze before all reported fits

decisions.question: How to handle norm-square underflow?
decisions.suggestion: Log-domain unit normalization and the mathematically redundant amplitude upper bound; rerun all parametric cases

decisions.question: How to progress while the shared GPU is occupied?
decisions.suggestion: Validate the same primitive family on CPU, run identical controls, preassign remaining cohorts by availability, and hand off explicitly when CUDA is available

decisions.question: How to reduce CPU rendering cost without changing the line family?
decisions.suggestion: Use exact Gaussian recurrences after full-domain value/gradient validation and the same 64 positive controls; rotate complete cases across available dataset leases

protocol.positive_control_noise: fixed independent Gaussian noise on causal pixels, scaled to Frobenius norm 0.01 times the clean target; no clipping of observations
protocol.fbp_reference: skimage radon/iradon, 90 angles step 2 degrees, circle=False, ramp filter, raw output as phase0

execution_resources_actual.checkpoint_reassignment: Stopped only verified Windows PID 40416 and its child to remove Pythia-410M from that future queue; resumed GPT-2 prefix unchanged and assigned Pythia-410M to the third CPU worker. No model or instance dropped.

cpu_backend_initial_timing_assessment.reason: Synthetic all-budget 100 Adam updates plus 150 L-BFGS-B iterations took 150.9 seconds; faster validated GPU backend retained
cpu_backend_initial_timing_assessment.historical_assessment_superseded_by: out/phase19_cpu_backend_protocol_frozen.json and out/phase19_recurrence_protocol_frozen.json; final usage is in parametric_renderer_counts

cpu_backend_protocol.reason: Shared GPU unavailable for more than 35 minutes after previous E2 batch; three CPU workers are free. Use CPU in parallel until explicit GPU handoff. Backend chosen by availability, not errors.
cpu_backend_protocol.validation_required: Identical 64 n256 synthetic cases with unchanged thresholds, separately reported before real CPU fits
cpu_backend_protocol.handoff: Explicit cancellation at next renderer evaluation, complete JSONL prefix retained, native Windows per-dataset FileLock; GPU remains under global Linux flock

cpu_recurrence_protocol.reason: Exact Gaussian recurrence reduces expensive repeated exponentials; separately validated values and gradients over the full allowed domain before real fits. Three CPU workers rotate one complete case per dataset lease while shared GPU is occupied.
cpu_recurrence_protocol.assignment: Round-robin availability, one case per native dataset lease; completed older CPU/CUDA cases retained; never compare errors to choose backend
cpu_recurrence_protocol.renderer_accumulation: float64, exact Gaussian recurrence without fast-math
cpu_recurrence_protocol.controls_required: same 64 fixed n256 planted cases, same reconstruction thresholds, before real recurrence fits

cpu_recurrence_runtime.reason: Prevent inactive OpenMP thread pools from busy-waiting while another numerical runtime executes; mathematical operations, thread counts, seeds, starts and budgets unchanged

parametric_normalization_by_backend.cuda: Log-domain unit normalization including transverse taper, float32 rendering
parametric_normalization_by_backend.cpu: Same normalized atom, float64 norm/render accumulation avoiding square underflow over the declared parameter bounds; float32 parameters and loss

limitations: Fixed 64-instance stratified subset per dataset; 64 document blocks; layer/head estimates do not cover all archived heads.
Planted positive controls cover k=1,2,4,8; parametric truth widths are 0.6..4 pixels and decay -4..4. They do not certify global optimization at larger k or over every allowed primitive parameter.
Finite angle, offset and decay grids; finite nonconvex optimization and four initializations do not exclude other line representations or global optima.
Best-line summary selects a method on these evaluation errors; it is an optimistic descriptive envelope, not a separately validated compressor.
SVD is not causally remasked: whole-matrix rank approximation is scored exactly as phase05; this experiment makes no downstream or inference-causality claim.
Same component count is not the same storage cost; the two comparisons are kept separate.
Any failed positive control or nonconvergence remains in every paired aggregate and limits a negative scientific interpretation.

Some n=256 parametric fits use float64 CPU rendering with float32 parameters/loss; CUDA uses float32 rendering. Value/gradient equivalence and identical positive controls are reported separately. Numerical nonconvex paths can differ; backend assignment and handoff depend only on resource availability, never on fitted error.

subsample_engineering_evidence.estimation: Extrapolate per-dataset measured fit time by source_matrices/selected_matrices and observed CPU/CUDA backend mix; core CPU estimate excludes parametric fits, separately reported; excludes setup, aborted handoff cases and GPU lock waits; not a benchmark of unselected matrices or a controlled backend speed comparison

control_development_history.initial_optimizer: 450 Adam steps, three starts; failed synthetic mixtures
control_development_history.final_optimizer: Four starts including multiscale proposals; 450 Adam steps followed by up to 150 L-BFGS-B iterations

numerical_stability_revision.issue: Float32 norm squares underflowed for a line barely intersecting the causal region; first three real fits preserved in an unused baseline cache
numerical_stability_revision.fix: Compute unit-norm atoms with log-sum-exp scaling, including the compact transverse taper; no nonfinite value was replaced by zero
numerical_stability_revision.amplitude_bound: 0 <= amplitude <= ||A||; coordinatewise NNLS optimum for nonnegative unit-norm atoms is always within this bound
numerical_stability_revision.policy: All selected instances and all parametric positive controls rerun using the stable renderer; same seeds and grids
numerical_stability_revision.cpu_backend: The optional CPU fallback evaluates the same normalized atom in float64; identical controls and a separate backend source freeze are reported
